settings.heading: Spring/Summer 2025
settings.text:
The Shamballa Jewels Spring/Summer 2025 collection draws inspiration from the five elements of Hinduism, each symbolizing a force of nature.

Prithvi (Earth) grounds us in strength, Akasha (Ether) connects all things,
Vayu (Air) embodies freedom, Jal (Water) flows with transformation
and Agni (Fire) ignites emotion.

Crafted with timeless artistry, this collection channels the balance between the 5 elements and gemstones like no other.
